# Project Wren

Project Wren measures soil moisture on upland farms, to help farmers plan
grazing through dry summers.

## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[teodor-halim]] and runs from the
[[harrowgate-annex]]. Soil samples are read with the [[spectro-cart-sc7]].
